subject.title: [Bug] Cyclic dependency deadlock during plugin resolution

question: Should OpenClaw support first-class hard or soft inter-plugin dependency declarations and ordered activation, or should this report be limited to a concrete recursion reproducible through existing plugin APIs?
rationale: The proposed graph algorithm assumes a dependency surface that current manifest documentation does not define, so implementation would otherwise introduce product and compatibility semantics rather than repair an established contract. citeturn640099view0turn969567view0

options.title: Require a supported reproduction
options.body: Keep the scope to an existing loader bug and request a minimal current-main fixture, exact command, stack trace, and logs before changing resolution behavior.

options.title: Sponsor dependency ordering
options.body: Define manifest fields, hard-versus-soft semantics, activation ordering, diagnostics, compatibility behavior, and cycle handling as an explicit plugin API feature.

recommendation.title: Require a supported reproduction
recommendation.body: Keep the scope to an existing loader bug and request a minimal current-main fixture, exact command, stack trace, and logs before changing resolution behavior.
